body.x: Claire S (CEO Lee Woo-heon) will participate in 'CES (Consumer Technology Show) 2017', which is the world's largest IT appliance exhibition in Las Vegas,and reveal the new concept sound therapy air cleaner 'Claire S' from January 5th to 8th.
Clair is located in Hall G - 52905 booth and will introduce a variety of products to worldwide buyers including Claire V, Claire, Claire B, and Claire Cube, as well as sound therapy Claire S.

The new Claire S is a new concept that combines excellent air purification with IoT technology and Bluetooth speakers. It is a sound therapy air purifier that includes sound recording for sleep induction, meditation, mind and body stability, concentration.

It can be controlled by a smartphone app and can be applied to various situations such as listening to music in everyday life, inducing sleep, healing, stabilization, concentration and concentration in studying and work.

The Claire V, a new product introduced to global buyers along with Claire S, is an excellent air purifier with excellent odor deodorization and antibacterial functions throughout the house. It is good for use in refrigerator, shoe box, car, toilet, and it is effective because it can be used for 3 months with one battery.

Clairring is a product that can be placed in any room, and has a minimal size and cool design with excellent air purification capability. The Claire Cube is similar in size to the Clairring and is square in shape, which makes you enjoy not only the interior effect but also the excellent air cleaning effect. Claire B is a portable air purifier in the form of a tumbler that can prevent air pollution in smaller spaces such as inside a car.

All of Claire's shows excellent air purification ability with electrostatic dust collecting MAF filters patented in 27 countries, and MAF filters are safe because they are not chemically coated with OIT or chemically treated.

It removes more than 99% of ultrafine dust below 0.1μm, as well as substances causing allergies and sick house syndrome, and collects all harmful substances including yello dust, tobacco smoke. With a low electricity bill of about 100 won per month, you can reduce the burden on the household, and you can drink clean and fresh air at any time.

In Taiwan, it is popular so that it one of it is sold every 7 minutes, and it has reached 100% in the first 5 hours of the crowd funding of China Jingdong.com and reaches the final 284%. Thanks to its incredible popularity, it opened Claire's exclusive brand store at Jingdong.com for the first time as a Korean start-up company.

In 2015, the KickStarter of the United States, it exceeded 200%, and the US Indiegogo exceeded 200%. In Korea, Wadiz has achieved a target of 287%, and, Makuake crowdfunding in Japan, which is currently ongoing has already exceeded 200% at the end of 40 days from the end date.
